name: Fantasy: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Fantasy look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, epic fantasy concept painting, painterly brushwork, ornate hand-crafted armour and cloth, ancient architecture with real scale, golden light through mist, rich jewel-tone palette, volumetric god rays, atmospheric depth
negative_prompt: modern clothing, guns, cars, sci-fi technology, photographic snapshot look, text, watermark
